description: Defines the interface 'Http2FrameDecoderListener' for handling events during HTTP/2 frame decoding, including methods for different frame types, error handling, and a no-op implementation.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoderListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving callbacks during HTTP/2 frame decoding, covering various frame types, payloads, and error conditions.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoderNoOpListener
classes.description: A concrete implementation of Http2FrameDecoderListener that ignores all callbacks, useful for ignoring invalid frames.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Called after decoding the common frame header; returns false to stop decoding, true to continue.

methods.name: OnDataStart
methods.description: Called when a DATA frame's payload begins.

methods.name: OnDataPayload
methods.description: Called with chunks of data from a DATA frame.

methods.name: OnDataEnd
methods.description: Called after the entire DATA frame has been received.

methods.name: OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Called when a HEADERS frame's payload begins.

methods.name: OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Called when a HEADERS frame with PRIORITY flag is received.

methods.name: OnHpackFragment
methods.description: Called with fragments of HPACK-encoded header blocks.

methods.name: OnHeadersEnd
methods.description: Called when a HEADERS frame has been fully received.

methods.name: OnPriorityFrame
methods.description: Called when a PRIORITY frame is decoded.

methods.name: OnContinuationStart
methods.description: Called when a CONTINUATION frame's payload begins.

methods.name: OnContinuationEnd
methods.description: Called when a CONTINUATION frame has been fully received.

methods.name: OnPadLength
methods.description: Called when Pad Length field is read.

methods.name: OnPadding
methods.description: Called when padding bytes are skipped.

methods.name: OnRstStream
methods.description: Called when an RST_STREAM frame is decoded.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Called when a SETTINGS frame begins.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Called for each setting parameter in a SETTINGS frame.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Called after all SETTINGS parameters are processed.

methods.name: OnSettingsAck
methods.description: Called when a SETTINGS frame with ACK flag is decoded.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseStart
methods.description: Called when a PUSH_PROMISE frame begins.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseEnd
methods.description: Called when a PUSH_PROMISE frame is fully received.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Called when a PING frame without ACK is decoded.

methods.name: OnPingAck
methods.description: Called when a PING frame with ACK is decoded.

methods.name: OnGoAwayStart
methods.description: Called when a GOAWAY frame begins.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Called with opaque data from a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayEnd
methods.description: Called when a GOAWAY frame is fully decoded.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdate
methods.description: Called when a WINDOW_UPDATE frame is decoded.

methods.name: OnAltSvcStart
methods.description: Called when an ALTSVC frame begins.

methods.name: OnAltSvcOriginData
methods.description: Called with origin data of an ALTSVC frame.

methods.name: OnAltSvcValueData
methods.description: Called with value data of an ALTSVC frame.

methods.name: OnAltSvcEnd
methods.description: Called when an ALTSVC frame is fully decoded.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateStart
methods.description: Called when a PRIORITY_UPDATE frame begins.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdatePayload
methods.description: Called with chunks of the Priority Field Value.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateEnd
methods.description: Called when a PRIORITY_UPDATE frame is fully received.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Called when an unknown frame type begins.

methods.name: OnUnknownPayload
methods.description: Called with payload of an unknown frame.

methods.name: OnUnknownEnd
methods.description: Called when an unknown frame is fully decoded.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Called when padding length exceeds frame payload.

methods.name: OnFrameSizeError
methods.description: Called when a frame size error is detected.
